notes.note: Scoped offline-reading delta review: stable connection/origin/credential authority/state binding replaces request generation; AuthorityQueryContext retains verified account fencing. Both authenticatedFetch and mutateJson apply host mutation availability. Current reachability failures block writes, reads/probes recover, and navigator.onLine alone cannot veto a reachable server. Real SDK chat transport unavailability still reaches the outbound queue hook. Offline design, Connect, SDK and user guidance updated. Remaining impacted composition claims need no prose change: native custody, origin binding, SSE cursors, endpoint precedence, CLI configuration, public plugin imports, layout and theming are unchanged by these hunks. Focused tests exercise ConnectionStore, IndexedDB, Project SDK callers, browser credential recovery and chat queueing; no native/provider/release qualification claimed.
